prompts.rose-window-scriptorium:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. Design a focused primary desktop screen, not a feature inventory. Dimensions 1440 x 1024; one full app viewport, no browser chrome, no device, no montage. Use case: ui-mockup. Product: StoryOS, a novel-writing workspace; this image is its new real-time 3D private-writer magical library project entry. The user adopted the recommendation: one SMALL walkable private chamber, exactly FIVE individual book-display lecterns, not an enormous library or masses of books. Central magic book-creation table. Optional first-person roaming and direct Quick Access must coexist. Spectacular but intimate and achievable stylized-realism 3D art: richly modeled walnut, carved stone, antique brass, leather, warm candlelight and cool blue moonlight, sparse dust. A real space viewed from standing eye height with navigable floors and human scale; no isometric dollhouse, no top-down scene. Show overview state, not opening animation: no visible person or hands in this frame. Books are large artifact volumes, one per display stand; two stands can be empty so creation has room. The attached existing StoryOS editor screenshot is ONLY reference for restrained literary Chinese UI typography, warmth, spacing and minimal controls, not for the scene, layout, prose, editor panels or light background. This new library deliberately has a dark fantasy environment. Do not show a writing editor, chat, metrics grid, sidebar tree or giant promotional headline. Keep environment readable, dark but not crushed black. 3D scene must fill almost all frame. HTML labels must be legible clean typesetting, not engraved tiny illegible model text. At most two calm supporting UI areas; use space and alignment before borders and shadows; no cards inside cards. At most two font families, refined CJK serif for literary titles and clear sans serif controls, body 14-16px. Exact brand: "StoryOS". Sample titles available: "星海余烬", "众星之墓", "无名之海". Other exact UI words where needed: "我的藏书室", "继续写作", "全部作品", "新建故事", "探索藏书室", "搜索作品", "⌘ K". Use only the controls asked for in the direction below. No extra dates, stats, badges, gameplay HUD, health bars, weapon, crosshair, neon cyberpunk, purple SaaS gradients, mass book walls, NPCs, excessive postprocessing or heavy mist. Preserve the same accepted product; vary room composition and UI emphasis tastefully. Leave all objects and text uncropped. No explanatory outside labels, no concept name printed in image.
Direction name: Rose-window Scriptorium. Strong axial composition but an intimate chamber roughly 8m across: modest Gothic ribbed vault, a large but room-scaled circular stained-glass rose window centered on the back wall. Cold moonlight from the window touches a stone circular creation table with a very faint thin warm-gold rune ring in the midground center. Five individual walnut lecterns arranged in a spacious horseshoe on either side and rear; three hold closed jewel-toned leather books, two empty. Include charming brass candle sconces and carved arches. The camera stands at the entrance with clear floor foreground. A left-front lectern with a burgundy book is prominent, one restrained floating Chinese title label "星海余烬" beside it. UI: small top-left StoryOS and "我的藏书室"; top-right text button "全部作品" with tiny "⌘ K". Bottom-left small elegant ivory title "星海余烬", short label "继续上次的故事", and one warm-ivory filled action "继续写作"; not boxed in a large card. A tiny center-lower understated "探索藏书室" control. Near the central tabletop a small world-anchored label "新建故事". UI edges 40px margins. Literary, quiet, meticulously crafted, visually grounded, premium real-time game environment art.

Direction name: Hearthside Cabinet. Compose an asymmetrical intimate writer's chamber, with warm practical hearth and a small cushioned reading alcove to the left, a tall narrow Gothic window with blue moonlight to the back right, low walnut paneling and sculpted limestone walls. Five standalone lecterns create a gently curved path, including two empty stands, never densely stocked shelving. Central creation apparatus is a beautiful sturdy round walnut desk with a brass inlaid geometric ring, empty at idle; a quiet halo of warm sparks is minimal. Frame from entrance slightly angled toward a large deep green leather project volume on the near-right lectern, with "众星之墓" in a readable floating label. Deeper spatial composition with warm/cool interplay, comfortable private domestic scale, detailed material wear, no giant hall. UI treatment emphasizes a slim 260px warm-ivory quick-access panel open along the left edge below a small StoryOS wordmark, leaving over 75% of frame for the room. Panel typography and restrained separators echo the attached StoryOS editor, no cards: heading "我的藏书室"; primary highlighted row "星海余烬" and "继续写作", then plain text project rows "众星之墓" and "无名之海"; bottom two quiet text controls "搜索作品" with "⌘ K" and "探索藏书室". Only the highlighted continue action has visual emphasis. At creation desk a delicate anchored "新建故事" label. The panel must feel like a useful compact reading index belonging to a literary product, not a dashboard or inventory screen. Strong visual hierarchy; realistic tactile warm room with tiny distant embers.

Direction name: Moonlit Orrery. A compact octagonal writer's observatory chamber, human-scaled about 7m wide, with restrained antique brass meridian arcs high near ceiling, carved stone wall niches and dark walnut base paneling. Blue moonlight enters a sloped high arched window toward back-left; five separate stone-and-walnut book pedestals are arranged along the perimeter, exactly three books and two vacant. Make the central magic table a waist-high circular stone table with a thin brass astrolabe inset, pale warm light gathering only within its small engraving. No science-fiction holograms, no floating planets, no huge dome. Camera at standing eye level, slight off-axis composition placing the glowing table on right-middle and a large closed navy leather book on a near-left lectern; labels "无名之海" beside that volume. Moody but readable with warm candles to counter the cobalt moonlight, finely worn materials and a few dust particles. UI uses minimal top-left StoryOS and "我的藏书室"; top-right small "全部作品" text button with "⌘ K". Bottom center a narrow horizontal warm-ivory quick-return strip, about 520px wide and 76px high, with tiny label "继续上次的故事", title "星海余烬", a single strong "继续写作" button at the right, separated by space rather than cards. Beneath it tiny unobtrusive "探索藏书室". Label "新建故事" anchors closely to the magic tabletop. All UI is crisp and calm, mostly screen area remains the authentic 3D room. Optical polish without gigantic architecture or bloom.
